title: Am I going to get in trouble for asking for help?
body: This is one of the first questions people actually have, and we don't want to skip past it just because we don't have a good answer yet.

The honest truth right now is: we don't have a legally reviewed answer to give you here. Guessing would be worse than saying nothing, so this page is a placeholder until a legal or clinical partner writes it properly.
If you need to know before you make a call, NAMS is the appropriate place to ask that exact question directly — you can ask what happens before you say anything else.
